Added a `--json` flag to `habit list`: `src/commands.js`'s `list()` now takes an options object and returns `JSON.stringify([{name, done, streak}, ...])` when `json: true`; `src/cli.js` detects `--json` in argv and passes it through. Added a test and verified both plain and `--json` output manually — all 8 tests pass.

One decision I made without asking: the JSON shape includes `name`, `done` (raw done-day array), and computed `streak` per habit, rather than just `name`/`streak` (matching the plain-text view) or the raw habit object alone. Let me know if you'd prefer a leaner shape.
